reviews.title: Trash support, trash card
reviews.comment: Since I plugged in the card, I've had intermittent input freeze. It can get so bad that both mouse and keyboard inputs are not just not smooth, but do not respond for seconds at a time. Plug in my old gaming card, problems go away. The only reason I keep this is because Solidworks is even more trash and requires more RAM than the average supercomputer a couple years ago. I'm on my second RMA, multiple months of talking to support staff, and still no resolution in sight. All staff agree that my build looks fine, there is no reason for the freezing happening. The fact that it took over a month (without the card mind you, I had to send it in to get the first RMA) for the first replacement, another month of negotiation for the second replacement, and still no solution is worrying. I hate to say it as a long term fan of AMD and hater of Nvidia's general business practices, but stay away from AMD graphics. It's a dumpster fire.
